author: pcguidelk
body:
Surge protectors are an essential tool for safeguarding our electronic devices against power surges. A power surge is an unexpected, uncontrolled, temporary spike in current or voltage in an electrical circuit. These surges can happen due to internal or external factors and can cause significant damage to our electronic appliances.

Cipe Surge Protective devices (SPD) provide an effective solution to protect your electronic devices from being damaged or destroyed due to power surges. These devices work by acting as the most sensitive point in the phase. So, when a surge occurs, CIPE activates within milliseconds to ground the surge before it reaches any other appliance within that phase. Cipe SPD has been tested to protect from surges up to 6000v, which is not seen in other SPDs in the market.

One of the key advantages of Cipe SPD over conventional surge protectors is that a single device is enough to protect all electronics and electrical appliances within a single phase. In contrast, with conventional surge protectors, a single protector is required to bypass one individual electronic device. Additionally, most surge protectors in the market are of lower quality and do not protect devices up to 6000v. There are also some surge protectors that require specific knowledge to install, but with Cipe SPD, you just need to plug it into a plug point, which makes it easy for anyone to use.

There are two types of SPDs that Cipe offers – Power Only device and All-in-one device. The Power Only device protects all your electronics from power surges. The All-in-one device does the same job, and additionally, it has bypass protection for your telephone and LAN (internet) lines.

When it comes to installing Cipe SPD, you just need to plug it directly into a main plug point. It is essential to ensure that the wall plug point has proper ground connection to the premises. The CIPE device can be placed anywhere as it has a classy and sleek design.

Cipe SPD comes with a 1-year factory defect warranty available from the date of purchase. If there is a surge over 6000v, it may fry or damage the motherboard. In such cases, Cipe offers repairing or replacement services at a fee.

Power surges can cause significant damage to our electronic appliances, and it is essential to protect them using surge protectors. With its advanced protection capabilities, easy installation, and sleek design, Cipe SPD is an excellent choice for protecting your electronic devices.
headline: Cipe Surge Protector- The ultimate protection against power surges.
